packageRules.description: Dev tooling: grouped, and merged once CI passes.
Capacitor core and plugins move together.
pdf.js is pinned: its worker, cmaps and fonts are copied into the build, and its API changes between minors. Every bump is reviewed by hand after npm run test:pdf.
prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `npm run test:pdf`, then open a scanned PDF, a password PDF and a PDF with an outline on a phone.
